DomainData.MainInfoText:
Welcome to DIRECTV's Privacy Hub!

Here you can: (i) opt out of the cookies, pixels, and other tracking tools on our websites ("Tracking Technologies") that may make your personal information available to third parties in a way that is considered a sale, sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising ("sharing"), or targeted advertising under applicable consumer privacy laws, and (ii) opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information or targeted advertising that does not involve Tracking Technologies on our websites.

  • Opt Out of Tracking Technologies on Our Websites. To opt out, go to the "Our Websites" tab below and slide the toggle to the "OFF" position and save your choice. If you are an existing DIRECTV customer and are logged into your account (i.e., you are a “known user”) and you live in California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, or Virginia (“Regulated States”), opting-out of Tracking Technologies will also opt you out of the sale or sharing of personal information or targeted advertising that does not involve Tracking Technologies on our websites.
  • Opt Out of Sales, Sharing, and Targeted Advertising Not Involving Tracking Technologies on Our Websites. If you live in California, you may opt out by using this webform. If you live in any other Regulated State (see the list of states above), you may opt out by using this webform.
  • Opt Out by Logging into Your Account. All DIRECTV customers may log into their account to opt out of Tracking Technologies on our websites and Personalized Advertising in the programming on our TV Services, and if you live in one of the Regulated States you may also opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information or targeted advertising that does not involve Tracking Technologies on our websites. To opt out, go to the Privacy Preference Center on your Profile page to manage your choices.
  • Opt-out Preference Signals. If you access a DIRECTV website from one of the states listed in our Opt-Out Preference Signal Notice, you may also opt out of Tracking Technologies on our websites by setting an opt-out preference signal that we recognize, like the Global Privacy Control. If we recognize you, we will also apply the opt-out preference signal to your account and to the applicable sale or sharing opt out that does not involve Tracking Technologies.

Read our Privacy Policy.

Want to opt-out of Tracking Technologies on Our Websites?

  • Slide the toggle to the "OFF" position.
  • Save your selection.
  • You have now opted out of Tracking Technologies on our Websites.
  • If you change your mind, you can opt back in by sliding the toggle to the "ON" position and again saving your selection.

What Are Tracking Technologies on Our Websites? Tracking Technologies are cookies, pixels and other tracking tools on our websites that may make your personal information available to third parties in a way that is considered a sale, sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising ("sharing"), or targeted advertising under applicable consumer privacy laws.

Please Note:

  • Your opt-out applies only to the browser and device you are using right now. If you visit our site using a different browser or device, you'll need to opt out again.
  • If you block or delete Tracking Technologies, your opt-out choice may not be saved or may stop working.
  • You'll still get ads, but you won't get ads that rely on Tracking Technologies on our websites.
  • If you are an existing DIRECTV customer and are logged into your account (i.e., you are a “known user”) and you live in California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, Oregon, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, or Virginia (“Regulated States”), opting-out of Tracking Technologies will also automatically opt you out of the sale or sharing of personal information or targeted advertising that does not involve Tracking Technologies on our websites.
  • If you live in California you may also opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information that does not involve Tracking Technologies on our websites by using this webform. If you live in any other Regulated State (see the list above), you may also opt out by using this webform.

Opt-Out Preference Signal: If you access a DIRECTV website from one of the states listed in our Opt-Out Preference Signal Notice, you may also opt out of Tracking Technologies on our websites by setting an opt-out preference signal that we recognize, like the Global Privacy Control. If we recognize you, we will also apply the opt-out preference signal to your account and to the applicable sale or sharing opt out that does not involve Tracking Technologies.

Want to learn more?

  • To learn more about how we use Tracking Technologies, and how we use your personal information for advertising, please read our Cookie Notice and our Advertising Notice.
  • Read our Privacy Policy.

California Consumers


The California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) gives California consumers the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information, as well as the right to limit certain uses of sensitive personal information.

With respect to the sale or sharing of personal information, we offer California consumers the ability to opt out of the following:

  • The sale or sharing using Tracking Technologies on our websites; and
  • Other sales or sharing of personal information that do not involve Tracking Technologies on our websites.

To opt out of the sale or sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising using Tracking Technologies on our websites, click on the “Our Websites” tab and follow the instructions.

You may also opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information that does not involve Tracking Technologies on our websites by submitting a Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information request using this webform. You may also use this webform to submit a request to limit the use of your sensitive personal information.

Opt-Out Preference Signal: When we detect an opt-out preference signal that we recognize, such as the Global Privacy Control, we will opt you out of the sale or sharing for cross-context behavioral advertising on our websites as described in the "Our Websites" tab of this Privacy Hub. In addition, if we recognize you when you access a DIRECTV website, we will also apply the opt-out preference signal as your election to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information that does not involve Tracking Technologies on our websites.

If you are an existing DIRECTV customer, you may also log into your account to submit a Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information request in our Privacy Preference Center.

For more information about your privacy choices, please see the California section at Your Privacy Choices.

Read our Privacy Policy.
